'''''Euphorbia graminea''''' is a species of plant in the family [[Euphorbiaceae]]. It is native to Mexico, [[Central America]], the Caribbean (Cuba, the Dominican Republic, Windward Islands, Aruba, and the Netherlands Antilles) [[Andes|Andean]] [[South America]] (Colombia, Venezuela, Ecuador, Peru, Bolivia, and northwestern Argentina), Suriname, and French Guiana.<ref name = powo/>
